name: Four Fangs Bite Into Her Tender Flesh
source:
In a manor behind red curtains lies an abattoir – and a coffin where two women sleep. On a deserted road, Angela’s engine dies. She finds the house, knocks, and asks for help. Elisabetta smiles and lets her in.

[From [url=https://solflo.itch.io/four-fangs]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
红色窗帘后面的庄园里有一个屠宰场，还有一口棺材，里面睡着两个女人。在一条荒无人烟的道路上，安吉拉的引擎熄火了。她找到了房子，敲门并寻求帮助。伊丽莎白微笑着让她进来。

[来自[url=https://solflo.itch.io/four-fangs]Itch.io[/url]]
